title: Chirality as evidence for God in The Case for God

tellings.quote: I put this in a book uh years ago uh the case for God.

plain: Chirality, the way the molecules of life come in a left-handed or right-handed form, is offered as evidence for God. Greg Rogers, a NASA doctor, says on the show that he made this argument years ago in a book, The Case for God. If he is right, the chemistry of life itself would point to a designer.
